_comment: Copy to build-plugins.config.json and edit the two target roots.
targets.<name>.root is the game's or server's ...\Binaries\Win64 folder;
the script appends ModLoader\<destination> (destination defaults to Plugins).
Per plugin you may override: solution, configurations {client,server},
outputDir, destination (Plugins or Preload), copyPdb, msbuildProperties.
